messages:
maya: Quick bring-up note — ran a quant sweep on nova-9b yesterday, attaching a short scorecard below.
ryan: Nice. TL;DR? cost vs quality numbers?
anika: can you drop the artifact link or paste the key table here?
maya: paste: ```
SCORECARD: nova-9b quant sweep (canonical-eval)
- float16 baseline: p95 220ms, avg tokens/req 420, quality=100.0 (ref)
- int8: p95 190ms, tokens/req same, quality=99.6 (-0.4), cost/unit ~0.68x
- int4: p95 160ms, quality=97.9 (-2.1), some longform QA slices show -4 to -6 point EM
- hybrid (int4 short + int8 long): p95 165ms, quality=99.1 (-0.9), cost/unit ~0.55x
```
ryan: appreciate the table. can you share how you computed cost/unit?
maya: cost calc: GPU token cost proxy: float16 = $0.0025 per 1k tokens, int8 ~0.0017 (68%), int4 ~0.0014 (56%). multiplied by avg tokens/req yields $/req.
lina: product ask: for GTN default, they'd prefer lower cost if quality drop <1%. what do you recommend?
manika: (typo) anika: we should call out corner slices — hallucination on legal Qs in int4.
maya: correct — int4 shows hallucination spike on 3 legal/trustworthiness slices (precision falls). not acceptable for GTN legal flows.
ryan: operational note: int4 bake increases cache fragmentation risk; KV cache size smaller but more miss churn in multi-turn. p95 improved but tail jitter higher.
anika: for a canary, propose: default int8 for GTN + hybrid routing for low-latency non-sensitive paths. canary traffic: 5% for 48h.
lina: sounds reasonable. any rollback triggers we should set?
maya: suggest regression thresholds: overall eval delta_quality >1.0% OR slice-level delta >2.5% OR production user-feedback rate spike >50% vs baseline.
ryan: add infra triggers: latency p95 increase >15% or error rate >0.5% absolute. deploy-bot: deploy canary scheduled at 1742001800 if approvals in thread. :robot_face:
anika: Also recommend running A/B with a small GTN cohort routed to hybrid to measure end-to-end token cost and latency distribution (client-side metrics).
lina: Can we get a quick unit-econ one-pager for sales? they want per-1M token savings and estimated monthly $ impact at 100M tokens.
maya: quick math: baseline (float16) cost per 1M tokens = $2,500. int8 = $1,700 (save $800 /1M). int4 ~ $1,400 (save $1,100 /1M). hybrid effective ~ $1,375 depending on split. at 100M tokens -> int8 saves ~$80k/mo, int4 ~$110k/mo (but risk).
anika: we should also include expected perf uplift ops: int8 p95 -13%, int4 p95 -27%, but tail jitter caveat for int4.
lina: product wants final rec by EOD: 3-line recommendation + risk bullets. can someone draft?
maya: draft: "Recommend defaulting GTN to int8 quant for now (≈0.4% quality loss, ~32% token-cost savings). Enable hybrid routing for latency-sensitive, non-sensitive flows as an opt-in. Run 48h 5% canary with eval + user-feedback gates; block rollout if any slice regresses >2.5% or p95/err triggers hit."
ryan: +ops: "Ensure cache TTL reset and monitor KV cache miss rate, tail latency histograms, and OOM alerts during canary."
anika: I'll format into a one-pager and ping sales. can we add the short code folks asked for to run the same sweep?
maya: paste quick command: ```bash
./run_quant_sweep --model nova-9b --modes float16,int8,int4 --slices canonical-eval,legal-slice,longform-qna --out /artifacts/nova-quant-1742001111
```
ryan: perfect. I'll wire up deploy-bot for canary and add infra dashboards.
lina: thanks team — will update GTN and sales. small ask: tag the legal slice as "blocked-for-int4" in routing rules so we don't accidentally route legal flows to int4 hybrid.
manika: anika: done. routing rule added.
devops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by ryan at 1742001800. Reminder: monitor channel #eng-oncall.
maya: will add eval snapshots and a short sample of failure cases to the artifact.
anika: moving to action items: 1) canary + dashboards (ryan) 2) one-pager for sales (anika) 3) artifact + failure samples (maya) 4) routing rule for legal (anika).
lina: perfect, thanks. :thumbsup:
